overview.title: We unify channels, automate processes, and transform **interactions into results**.
overview.lead: With SigmaCX, every point of the customer journey gains consistency, intelligence, and fluidity.

items.title: Sigma Brain
items.body: It's not a standalone product, but rather part of the SigmaCX ecosystem. It's the platform's intelligent engine: it operates across all channels, executing actions to resolve end-to-end demands, combining context, automation and personalization.

items.title: Sigma Channel
items.body: Centralize all service channels on a single platform and have a complete and integrated view of interactions.

items.title: Sigma Insights
items.body: With SigmaCX, your conversations are no longer just records; they become input for improving customer service.

cases.title: Solutions we build together
cases.fractaliaLead: Sigma Insights modernizes service operations by offering greater **stability, efficiency and centralization**, resulting in higher productivity and more satisfied customers.

fractaliaResults.title: Fewer complaints
fractaliaResults.body: Fewer complaints about call quality and disconnections, thanks to greater platform stability.

fractaliaResults.title: Quality perception
fractaliaResults.body: Customer satisfaction reached 87% positive perception, 3 percentage points higher.

fractaliaResults.title: Higher productivity
fractaliaResults.body: Digital channels expanded without a proportional increase in headcount.

fractaliaResults.title: Multilingual service
fractaliaResults.body: Automatic translation in text channels served several languages without hiring agents.

cases.fractaliaQuote: When quality and technology meet, amazing results are born.
cases.tecbanLead: Sigma Insights has transformed call management with automated analytics, bringing operational efficiency and higher customer satisfaction.

tecbanResults.title: Positive customer sentiment
tecbanResults.body: Satisfaction grew from 4% in 2023 to 46% in 2025; neutral interactions fell from 90% to 22%.

tecbanResults.title: Less silence on calls
tecbanResults.body: Silence dropped from 29% to 25%, making interactions more objective.

tecbanResults.title: Greater operational efficiency
tecbanResults.body: Adjustments found by the analyses cut 23 seconds from handling time in specific flows.

tecbanResults.title: Fewer callbacks
tecbanResults.body: Script changes reduced the volume of repeat contacts.

cases.tecbanQuote: When listening to the customer turns into business results.
cases.lead: Results measured in the operations of companies already running SigmaCX.

intelligence.title: We transform every interaction into **strategic intelligence**
intelligence.lead: With SigmaCX, your conversations are no longer just records; they become input for improving customer service:

items.title: From conversation to insight
items.body: We transcribe and analyze interactions in real time, applying sentiment analysis, automatic categorization, and trend identification.

items.title: Data that generates action
items.body: Intuitive dashboards and strategic reports that reveal bottlenecks, anticipate problems, and guide operational changes.

items.title: Continuous efficiency
items.body: By automating workflows and reducing manual tasks, we increase team productivity and customer satisfaction.

intelligence.quote: Companies that use **analytics** achieve up to **23% higher revenue growth and 12% higher customer retention.**
intelligence.statLead: Companies that use **analytics** achieve measurable results.
